title: On Air Light
description: Configuration for the On Air tally light plugin

mqtt_host.title: MQTT Broker Host
mqtt_host.description: Hostname or IP address of your MQTT broker (e.g. your Home Assistant instance)

mqtt_username.title: MQTT Username
mqtt_username.description: Leave blank if no authentication is required

mqtt_password.title: MQTT Password
mqtt_password.description: Leave blank if no authentication is required

command_topic.title: Command Topic
command_topic.description: MQTT topic to subscribe to for ON/OFF commands. Accepts plain ON/OFF or JSON {"state":"on","label":"RECORDING","color":[255,20,20]}

state_topic.title: State Topic
state_topic.description: MQTT topic the plugin publishes to after each state change (publishes ON or OFF). Use this as state_topic in a Home Assistant MQTT switch.

default_label.title: Default Label
default_label.description: Text shown when activated without a label in the MQTT payload

default_color.title: Default Color
default_color.description: RGB glow color when activated without a color in the MQTT payload. Default is broadcast red.

pulse_enabled.title: Enable Pulsing
pulse_enabled.description: Animate the glow with a slow pulse for a live broadcast feel

pulse_speed.title: Pulse Speed (Hz)
pulse_speed.description: How fast the glow pulses (cycles per second). 1.2 Hz ≈ one breath per second.

display_duration.title: Standby Rotation Duration (s)
display_duration.description: How long to show the (dark) standby screen before rotating away when Off. Lower = cycles past faster.
